route_reason: Forward multiplies active state and/or active parameters, so it is not one fixed linear field-to-field map; frozen opspec v1 forbids continuous coefficients and requires a hand rule.

failure_records.meaning: one flag per refusal source_id; any nonzero flag refuses the gradient

b_tendency_snapshot.initialization: device-to-device copy of the complete output cotangent before adjoint

workspace.failure_records: 22 int32 source flags, zero before launch and check after; flag index is source_id minus one
workspace.scalar_reduction: first block accumulates per-thread f64 partial sums of f32 local derivatives in fixed order, then thread 0 reduces partials in thread order; requires block size at most 1024

topology_admission: Every edge is incident to two distinct valid cells, and each incident cell lists the edge once in edges_on_cell; no duplicate cell edges. nedges and tendency_elems are obtained from validated field extents.
accumulation: Each active cell or edge is owned by one reverse thread; h4 uses a deterministic first-block f64 partial reduction. No unordered atomics.
why: The full map multiplies multiple active inputs, including differentiable coefficients; the frozen opspec only admits fixed continuous coefficients.
cotangent_accumulation: Duplicate float32 input contributions are gathered in a deterministic float64 register and rounded once on output; scalar reductions use a fixed block/thread order.
shape_contract: Symbolic dimensions are resolved from the launch and fixed mesh; ninterfaces is the captured allocation extent and is at least nlev.

generator_reconciliation: The generator supports only fixed linear coefficients. This kernel multiplies independently active fields or parameters; no valid opspec describes the full map. The existing hand TL/AD is retained, with no frozen active coefficient.
seed_copy_contract: The saved snapshot is initialized from the incoming output cotangent before the reverse launch; it is disjoint from the consumed output buffer.
cotangent_binding_contract: Incoming output cotangents use the output-seed allocation and are consumed by the reverse entry; outgoing input cotangents use a separate accumulation allocation. Saved seed-copy bindings snapshot the incoming seed before the entry.
